# Skin segmentation positive reference

NASA portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins, distributed as scikit-image's
`astronaut` fixture. scikit-image documents the photograph as public domain.

- Source bytes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.24.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png
- Attribution and provenance: https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut

Used only to check that offline semantic segmentation can produce a positive
face-skin result. One portrait does not establish general detection accuracy.
